string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_clear_day
string-array.item: Professor Oak says it\'s a perfect day to start your Pokémon journey!
Pikachu is soaking up the sunshine outside.
Clear skies ahead, Trainer. Adventure awaits!

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_clear_day
string-array.item: Route 1 is wide open. Go catch \'em all.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_cloudy_day
string-array.item: A mysterious day for exploring tall grass.
Somewhere, a wild Pokémon is waiting to be discovered.
The weather may be gray, but adventure never is.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_cloudy_day
string-array.item: Keep your eyes on the tall grass.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_rainy_day
string-array.item: Looks like Squirtle called in some extra water support today.
A rainy route is perfect for Water-type Pokémon.
Don\'t forget your Pokédex, Trainer. Rain won\'t stop an adventure.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_rainy_day
string-array.item: Great fishing weather down by the route.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_stormy_day
string-array.item: Pikachu seems unusually excited about today\'s forecast.
Electric-type Pokémon are having the time of their lives.
Watch out, Trainer. The skies are using Thunder!

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_stormy_day
string-array.item: The Power Plant is buzzing with energy.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_snowy_day
string-array.item: Looks like an Ice-type Pokémon convention outside.
Perfect weather for a visit to Snowpoint City.
Even Lapras might be feeling chilly today.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_snowy_day
string-array.item: Better pack some Burn Heals… and a coat.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_foggy_day
string-array.item: A wild Pokémon could be hiding just beyond the mist.
The fog rolls in like a slow Confuse Ray.
Tread carefully, Trainer — visibility is low on this route.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_foggy_day
string-array.item: Bring a Pokémon that knows Defog.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_windy_day
string-array.item: Pidgeotto are riding the air currents today.
Flying-type Pokémon are out in full force.
The wind carries the promise of a new adventure.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_windy_day
string-array.item: A perfect tailwind for your next adventure.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_hot_day
string-array.item: Charmander is thriving in this heat.
Fire-types are feeling right at home today.
Stay hydrated, Trainer — even Growlithe is panting.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_hot_day
string-array.item: Quick — grab a Fresh Water from the vending machine.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_cold_day
string-array.item: Glaceon would feel right at home in this chill.
Bundle up, Trainer — it\'s a frosty route ahead.
Ice-type Pokémon are loving the cold snap.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_cold_day
string-array.item: Mt. Coronet weather, right here at home.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_clear_night
string-array.item: Clear night. Perfect for spotting a Clefairy.
The stars are out over Pallet Town, Trainer.
Professor Oak is still awake in the lab, apparently.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_clear_night
string-array.item: Save your game and look up for a minute.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_cloudy_night
string-array.item: No stars tonight. The tall grass looks darker than usual.
Something rustled out there. Probably a Rattata.
A good night to stay in the Pokémon Center.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_cloudy_night
string-array.item: Stay on the path after dark.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_rainy_night
string-array.item: Rain on the roof all night. Squirtle approves.
Water-types are having the time of their lives out there.
A wet night for anyone caught between towns.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_rainy_night
string-array.item: Good night for fishing, if you are brave.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_stormy_night
string-array.item: Thunder after dark. Pikachu is wide awake.
The Power Plant is lit up from here.
Electric-types do not believe in bedtime tonight.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_stormy_night
string-array.item: Unplug the PC box. Just in case.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_snowy_night
string-array.item: Snow falling in the dark. Very Snowpoint of it.
Ice-types are out there enjoying the quiet.
Everything will be buried by sunrise, Trainer.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_snowy_night
string-array.item: Pack Burn Heals and a very thick coat.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_foggy_night
string-array.item: Fog at night. Anything could be out in that.
Visibility zero. Bring a Pokémon that knows Flash.
The route signs have vanished entirely, Trainer.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_foggy_night
string-array.item: Defog would be extremely useful right now.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_windy_night
string-array.item: The wind is rattling the windows all night.
Flying-types are somewhere up there, enjoying it.
A rough night to be camping between towns.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_windy_night
string-array.item: Tie down the tent, Trainer.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_hot_night
string-array.item: Even the night is warm. Fire-types are delighted.
A muggy night on Route 1. Nobody is sleeping.
Growlithe has given up and sprawled on the floor.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_hot_night
string-array.item: Grab a Fresh Water. Sleep is optional.

string-array.name: pokemon_quotes_cold_night
string-array.item: A freezing night. Glaceon is thriving, you are not.
Cold enough to see your breath on Route 1.
Even the Pokémon Center heating is struggling.

string-array.name: pokemon_subtitles_cold_night
string-array.item: Mt. Coronet weather, right outside.
